title: Custom-Fabricated Functional Knee Orthoses
description: DME MAC coverage criteria for custom-fabricated functional knee orthoses (HCPCS L1845, L1846). Requires documented chronic knee instability resulting from ligamentous deficiency (ACL, PCL, MCL/LCL) or severe osteoarthritis, failed trial of prefabricated orthosis, and specific physical exam laxity measurements.

criteria.name: Documented Objective Knee Laxity or Ligamentous Deficiency
criteria.description: Physical examination documenting Grade II or III ligamentous instability on anterior drawer, Lachman, pivot shift, or varus/valgus stress testing.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: The beneficiary is ambulatory and has objective knee instability that must be supported by documentation of a physical examination including the joint laxity test(s) performed (see the POLICY SPECIFIC DOCUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS section in the LCD-related Policy Article; refer to the Group 4 ICD-10 Codes in the LCD-related Policy Article); or,

criteria.name: Medical Justification for Custom vs Prefabricated Device
criteria.description: Documented anatomical justification why an off-the-shelf prefabricated brace cannot fit (e.g. disproportionate thigh/calf circumference, severe angular deformity > 15 degrees).
criteria.source_text_excerpt: For knee orthoses definitions of off-the-shelf and custom fitted, refer to the CODING GUIDELINES section in the LCD-related Policy Article.

criteria.name: Temporary Post-Operative Immobilizer Exclusion
criteria.description: Custom functional brace requested solely for short-term post-operative immobilization (< 6 weeks) where a simple immobilizer is appropriate.
criteria.clinical_intent: Disqualify custom rigid braces for simple temporary immobilization
criteria.source_text_excerpt: A contracture is distinguished from the temporary loss of range of motion of a joint following injury, surgery, casting, or other immobilization.
